messages:
Jenna: Heads-up: SI shadow day scheduled for next Wed. Need owners for labs/hw access, trainer dry-run, cert gating, and partner announcement timeline.
Priya: Ill take badges & physical access (AD groups, door perms, signout). Need attendee emails by Mon morning.
Diego: Ill own the hands-on curriculum and vendor rack validation (A100 cluster + Trident board). Will pin demo model to redwood-demo-1.3.
Alex: I'll do VPC/VPN onboarding and ephemeral creds. Send me the test IPs and required CIDR ranges.
Sam: DevEx will produce a 20-min quickstart + calendar invite templates and a one-page checklist for attendees.
Mia: Training side: update cert path for the shadow cohort. Proposed format: 2-hour lab + 30-min practical. Pass threshold 80%. Need proctors.
Jenna: For hardware partners: confirm rack slots, power, cable labels, and an on-site contact to swap units. @Diego can you confirm driver/quant profiles preloaded?
Diego: Yes. Ill run smoke tests and push quant profiles. Also adding a KV/prefix cache sanity test.
Diego: Smoke test snippet:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-demo-1.3","input":"smoke: seq=64"}'
```
Priya: Badge plan: create AD group "SI-shadow-2026" -> Lab access + floor-3 rack. DMs for attendee lists please.
Alex: VPN quickstart: https://go.redwood/vpn-onboard. We'll provision certs then ephemeral API keys for demo role. Ensure demo role has KMS decrypt but no key export.
Sam: Quickstart sections: 1) API key basics 2) minimal runbook to swap model variants 3) triage tips (OOM recovery, latency spikes).
Mia: For certing: need proctors, proctor playbook, and a secure proctoring machine. @Priya can you confirm room + peripherals?
Priya: Room B reserved 9:00-13:00. Dongles and keyboards on the reserve cart. Facilities will check power strips and UPS.
Jenna: Marketing constraint: 48h lead and signed partner quote for any joint announcement. Can partnerships sign off by Tue EOD?
Diego: Request a trainer dry-run Mon 11:00 to validate flow. If dry-run passes, we can greenlight.
Sam: I'll schedule the trainer dry-run and shadow day invites.
onboard-bot: Task created: 1769891112  "SI shadow day - ops checklist" assigned to Priya. https://tasks.redwood/1769891112
Priya: Acknowledged. I'll post a living checklist doc in #partnerships by EOD with owners and deliverable dates.
Jenna: Final asks: 1) Trainer dry-run Mon 11:00; 2) Attendee emails to Priya by Mon 09:00; 3) DevEx quickstart by Tue 12:00; 4) Marketing go/no-go Tue EOD. Confirm?
Diego: Confirmed :thumbsup:
Alex: Confirmed
Sam: Confirmed
Mia: Confirmed
Priya: Confirmed, will share checklist link once posted.
Jenna: Thanks all. I'll chase partner ops on the signed quote and log the announcement window.
